opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to join an automated Bitcoin trading platform, sign up, and fund an account with Bitcoin, stating that they can start with as little as $100. It attributes increased daily earnings to artificial-intelligence trading and claims returns of 0.5% to 3% each day. The opportunity also extends beyond trading: viewers are told that bringing in people who place $100 on both sides creates binary qualification and produces more money. Affiliate participation is separately promoted with commissions of up to 10% for each person brought in, including an example of receiving $100 when someone deposits $1,000. These combined claims present account funding, daily returns, and recruitment-based compensation as the path to earnings.
